title: What’s New: AL Runtime and Database (2024 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Change log cleanup and alter key method
Actionable error improvements and test field navigation

features.name: Number sequence next/current/exist methods performance
features.description: Next, current, and exist methods on number sequences are now up to 32% faster than previous versions.

features.name: Number sequence restart method
features.description: New method allowing you to restart a number sequence to a particular number without having to drop and recreate the sequence.

features.name: Number sequence range start method
features.description: New method to get an interval of numbers in a single call without querying the database multiple times, reducing database calls from N to 1 when fetching ranges.

features.name: Change log entry cleanup optimization
features.description: Internal optimization of change log entry deletion to handle very large tables that previously would timeout during retention policy setup or bulk deletion.

features.name: Alter key method for on-premises
features.description: New method that disables keys during the current transaction to speed up bulk deletion of change log entries. Keys are automatically re-enabled when the transaction ends. Marked for on-premises only.
caveats: only viable for bulk deletion scenarios to avoid index rebuild overhead

features.name: Removal of force order and loop join server settings
features.description: Force order and loop join server settings have been removed in this release after being deprecated in version 23.

features.name: Field tooltips on table definition
features.description: Developers can now define field tooltips once at the table level and any page using those fields will automatically inherit them, reducing duplication and enabling future copilot features.
caveats: page-level tooltips can still override table-level ones

features.name: System tables for translatable texts
features.description: New system tables added to store translatable texts like tooltips and captions separately from object metadata, improving caching efficiency and reducing duplication.
caveats: tables will be visible in both tenant and app databases

features.name: Actionable errors with test field navigation
features.description: Test field method now automatically adds navigation links to failing data when specific conditions are met, allowing users to navigate directly to the problematic record without developer coding.
caveats: drill down page ID and card page ID must be available
only navigates if target is different page/record

features.name: Error handling documentation expansion
features.description: Expanded documentation for developers on error handling including failure modeling and robust coding practices for degrading gracefully and expressing errors in user-friendly language.

features.name: Runtime migration to .NET 8
features.description: Server runtime upgraded from .NET 6 to .NET 8, providing faster and more efficient runtime. This change is transparent to AL developers.

features.name: PowerShell 7 migration and backward compatibility bridge
features.description: Migration from PowerShell 5 to PowerShell 7 with a backward compatibility bridge through nav admin tool that relays PowerShell 5 calls to PowerShell 7 cmdlets.
caveats: PowerShell 5 will be deprecated within the next years
scripts that import assemblies directly may need minor changes
